token_can_execute_during_transfer_from.meaning: the token involved in addRewards is malicious and can execute code during transferFrom

accounting_increased_before_transfer_fro.meaning: pending-reward accounting has already been increased at the point of the external transferFrom in addRewards
accounting_increased_before_transfer_fro.checkpoint: during addRewards, after accounting update and before transferFrom completes

claim_rewards_reentered_during_transfer_.meaning: claimRewards or another entrypoint is re-entered while accounting has already been increased during addRewards transferFrom

griefing_occurs.meaning: the reentrancy during addRewards enables griefing
griefing_occurs.checkpoint: after reentrant call during addRewards transferFrom

assumptions: The token's transferFrom is the external call in addRewards during which reentry is possible.
claimRewards is an entrypoint reachable during the token's transferFrom callback.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who calls addRewards or whether the caller is authorized, so the applicability scope of the reentrancy window is not fully specified.
Report does not specify concrete token amounts or numeric bounds for the reentrancy window; the relation is represented qualitatively.

limitations: Griefing is represented as a qualitative Boolean outcome because the report provides no numeric magnitude or specific harmed quantity.
The plan formalizes only the selected impact 'griefing' for the single intent 'intent_no_reentry_window'; other impacts and intents are handled separately.
